### Biomes

Defined in `data/config/biomes.yaml`. Distributed via Voronoi zones (`voronoiCellSize: 256`, blend `20`) keyed on moisture × altitude.

| Biome | Surface | Subsurface | Altitude | Moisture | Max NPCs | Vegetation |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `snow_peaks` | SNOW | STONE | 150–1024 | 0.0–1.0 | 40 | pine_tree_snow @0.04 |
| `desert` | SAND | SANDSTONE | —–— | 0.0–0.25 | 10 | — |
| `dry_plains` | GRASS | DIRT | —–— | 0.25–0.30 | 30 | weed @0.08 |
| `plains` | GRASS | DIRT | —–— | 0.30–0.62 | 40 | flower @0.06, weed @0.05, oak_tree @0.01 |
| `forest` | GRASS | DIRT | —–— | 0.62–0.82 | 50 | oak_tree @0.12, flower @0.04, weed @0.04 |
| `pine_forest` | GRASS | DIRT | —–— | 0.82–1.0 | 40 | pine_tree @0.15, weed @0.03 |
